en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard featuring a large Ottoman‑era building with a central dome, ornate arched windows and façades, and an adjacent tall minaret. A dense crowd gathers in front, likely for a ceremonial event. Handwritten cursive text covers the lower part of the image. Printed French captions appear at the top left and right, and there is a visible website watermark added later for archival purposes.
